title: Yitzchak bar Yonatan

paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Niddah chapter 2: he and Rav [Huna] were sitting when a woman came and asked them. Yitzchak bar Yonatan said to her ... Rav Huna said to him, “Thus said Rav,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Niddah paragraph explicitly makes Yitzchak speak to the woman and Rav Huna speak to Yitzchak. The source’s bracketed [Huna] and abbreviated quotation are preserved.
